data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word "nola", which means "gentle wave". In Christian tradition, this name is associated with the gentle and soothing nature of the sea and the calmness it brings. The name Nolana carries the meaning “Gentle wave” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nolana usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle wave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A gentle wave of spiritual growth and transformation.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nolana total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
